correctness.rationale: Direct integration of both independently defined light states gives the three-exponential objective with P,Q,R>0. The derivative is e^{-bg} times a function B with B′<0 for all g>=0 because d>b, and its limit is strictly negative, proving existence, uniqueness and every boundary case of the optimizer. For the special rate family the exact quadratic 4-3u-3u^2 has one root in (0,1); monotonicity of the implicit positive root gives the increasing gap and ln 3 limit. The included checker reproduces direct integrals and examples and passed 12,050 tests; the analytic argument, not these tests, covers all admissible parameters.

value.rationale: The exact structural onset distinguishes genuinely optimal deliberate shade from uninterrupted exposure despite equal high-light photon input, in a model retaining the biologically important competition between persistent induction and faster recovery from light damage. The result provides a general global diagnostic for all positive rates with d>b, an exact critical pulse length and strictly increasing optimal gap in a transparent rate family, a finite-horizon capped law and a nonzero reproducible gain (29.27% at unit length). These are meaningful experimental-design benchmarks, not simply a numerical optimum or a claim about field efficacy.
